purpose: Granular milestone truth beneath the strategic Phase A-F roadmap. This is the only machine-readable milestone register. Future milestone IDs may be refined by Manager only by updating this file; strategic phases are not deleted.

strategicRoadmap.rule: Phase A-F remains the strategic roadmap. This register adds implementation-sized milestones and does not replace the phases.

sequence: verify each agent branch and focused evidence
reconcile backend contract and frontend consumption
classify mechanical, contract, architecture and scope conflicts
run shared alignment and full relevant gates
validate merge candidate against protected main
mergeProtocol.completionRule: An agent branch can be complete without the milestone being complete. P2.13 becomes complete only on reconciled, verified protected main.

milestones.title: Context & Session
deliverables: backend tests and frontend contract consumption
milestones.implementationBoundary: Context/session lifecycle, snapshots, references, compaction bookkeeping, checksum lineage, rollover, continuation serialization, rehydration, verification, bounded local state and presentation. Context is not Conversation, Session is not Context Window, Memory is not Context, and Execution is not implemented here.
decisionDependencies: no new XA row for implementation drift
Manager reconciliation PASS and MERGE PASS are required
completionCriteria: one Context & Session LEGO with no duplicate domain
locked contracts and exact frontend/backend vocabulary
context/session lifecycle and fail-closed invalid transitions
frontend shows explicit continuation/degraded/failure states without fabricated tokens
